verdict.rationale: The evidence shows the H200 being deployed as data-center and cloud infrastructure. The CUDA Toolkit targets enterprise data centers and cloud platforms, NIM microservices handle deployment, and a community report describes a production API running on H200 SXM, all of which implies unattended, programmatic use. Nothing explicitly documents headless operation or CI-pipeline automation. Missing for 10: explicit docs on headless/CI usage (e.g., containerized GPU runners, driver/CLI automation such as nvidia-smi in pipelines), plus hands-on corroboration of CI workflows.
